task:
Repo: ~/workspace/opencode-mobile. Cut YouTube Shorts (vertical 9:16, 15-60s each) from EXISTING footage only, no re-recording.

Source files (verified real, git-tracked, untapped):
- website/public/cua-showcase.mp4 (174s)
- docs/qa/screenshots/cua-connect-flow.mp4 (64.28s)
- docs-site/demo.mp4 (31.00s)

STEPS
1. ffprobe each file for exact duration/resolution.
2. Extract frames every ~5s (ffmpeg -vf fps=1/5) to a tmp dir and inspect them (Read tool on images) to identify distinct coherent app-flow segments (e.g. connect screen, session list, new session, chat, settings, model picker).
3. Cut each distinct segment with ffmpeg into its own file, re-encoded to vertical 1080x1920 (pad or crop as needed — cropping/padding existing footage is allowed, re-recording is not). Save to /tmp/shorts-out/short-NN-<name>.mp4.
4. Do NOT pad with near-duplicate segments — if cua-showcase.mp4 only really has 3 distinct flows, cut 3, not more.
5. Report: table of cut clips (path, duration, resolution, source file + timestamp range, one-line description of the flow shown).

This is prep only — do not upload anything yet.
